Matters concerning the Würzburg fiefs of the lords of Rosenberg.

Date range: 1485; 1496–1507; 1552–1574; 1600–1631.

Contents: (1) Folios 1–246: Suit brought by Bishop Julius of Würzburg before the knightly fief court of the Bishopric of Würzburg against Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg to reclaim his Würzburg fiefs on account of his failure to perform the feudal summons and his expulsion of Catholic priests from the parish of Kupprichshausen; Rosenberg’s counter-suit before the Imperial Chamber Court, 1600–1631. (2) Folios 247–248: Instruction from Bishop Melchior of Würzburg to his Amtmann zu Röttingen concerning seizure of the Würzburg fiefs of Zaisolph von Rosenberg because he entered the service of Konrad von Hanstein, 1551. (3) Folios 249–263: Copies of fief charters issued by the bishops of Würzburg to the lords of Rosenberg, 1485, 1496–1507, 1553, 1558, and 1574.

Extent: one volume, folios 1–263.
